cards.intuition: Sources land in ingestion, the lake normalizes them, pipelines chunk and embed, indexes serve, and the RAG endpoint answers with citations that trace back to the source.
cards.formula: sources -> ingestion -> lake -> pipelines -> indexes -> serving
cards.topic: Source-to-Serving Data Flow: Ingestion to Lake to Feature Store to Index to RAG Endpoint

cards.intuition: Bronze and silver are the corpus of record; gold, the chunks, embeddings, and indexes, is recomputable from silver by definition.
cards.topic: Source-to-Serving Data Flow: Ingestion to Lake to Feature Store to Index to RAG Endpoint

cards.intuition: Every stage gets a storage system, a transform, an owner, and an SLA, because monitoring, pricing, and replay all operate on named stages.
cards.topic: Source-to-Serving Data Flow: Ingestion to Lake to Feature Store to Index to RAG Endpoint

cards.intuition: Batch carries bulk passes cheaply; streaming carries what cannot wait, like revocations and price changes. Freshness times volume times cost picks each hop.
cards.formula: batch for bulk, streaming for what cannot wait
cards.topic: Batch vs Streaming Paths in the Backbone

cards.intuition: When a slow batch replay meets a newer streaming write, monotonic versions decide, not arrival order.
cards.topic: Batch vs Streaming Paths in the Backbone

cards.intuition: Forked batch and streaming logic drifts silently until an incident shows two different chunks from the same document. Run the same transforms in both modes.
cards.formula: same code, two modes; never two codebases
cards.topic: Batch vs Streaming Paths in the Backbone

cards.intuition: Schema, semantics, SLA, and failure behavior: the four things every arrow between components must specify to keep components replaceable.
cards.formula: contract = schema + semantics + SLA + failure behavior

cards.intuition: IDs hashed from document, version, span, and code version mean reprocessing the same input yields the same IDs, so replay after outages is safe.
Output that fails validation is quarantined and consumers stay on the last published snapshot; nothing is silently dropped or silently shipped.
cards.formula: fail validation -> quarantine, consumers see last good

cards.intuition: The lake's silver table is the truth for documents; chunks, embeddings, postings, vectors, and caches are derived, recomputable, and disposable.
cards.formula: any derived store can be wiped and rebuilt from truth
cards.topic: Single Source of Truth vs Derived Copies: Documents, Chunks, Embeddings

cards.intuition: Copies drift, so jobs continuously compare counts across truth and copies per generation and alert on divergence. Deletes and revocations must reach every copy.
cards.formula: truth count vs chunk count vs vector count, per generation
cards.topic: Single Source of Truth vs Derived Copies: Documents, Chunks, Embeddings

cards.intuition: If the index holds content the lake does not, the index has secretly become truth. If you cannot rebuild every index from the lake tonight, you already lost it.
cards.topic: Single Source of Truth vs Derived Copies: Documents, Chunks, Embeddings
